direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: HSROC

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Diagnostic HSROC analysis delegates sampling and summaries to the latest available archived HSROC package.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: pdftools

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Stock archived HSROC writes PDF plots; RCMetaR rasterizes them so the PyQt Results window can display HSROC plots as images.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: svglite

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Forest plot exports use svglite as the canonical vector rendering device so all output formats share one source artifact.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: rsvg
evidence: r/RCMetaR/R/plot_devices.R: rcmetar.export.svg_render converts canonical SVG files to PNG, PDF, and bitmap exports with rsvg
direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Forest plot PNG, PDF, and TIFF exports are derived from canonical SVG output through librsvg-backed conversion.

direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.name: tiff
evidence: r/RCMetaR/R/plot_devices.R: rcmetar.export.svg_render writes LZW-compressed TIFF files with tiff::writeTIFF(...)
direct_RCMetaR_dependencies.reason: Journal-oriented TIFF forest plot exports are written from the canonical SVG rasterization bitmap with LZW compression.
